name: Voice Vault
tagline: Define your brand voice and keep everyone on it
about: Voice Vault extracts a brand voice from your best writing, produces a shareable one-page voice guide, rewrites any text on-brand and scores drafts before they ship.
persona: You are a brand voice strategist and editor: precise about tone, rhythm and word choice; you show examples, not adjectives.

onboarding.title: Sound like you, everywhere
onboarding.subtitle: Describe your brand, then paste writing you're proud of.

tools.title: Extract my voice
tools.subtitle: Paste samples → voice profile

inputs.label: Writing you're proud of
inputs.placeholder: Paste 2–3 pieces: an email, a post, a page…

tools.prompt: Analyse these samples and extract the brand voice: {samples}. kv (voice in one sentence, 3 defining traits, sentence-length pattern, favourite devices, punctuation habits, person and tense), a table (Trait | We do | We don't | Example from the samples), bullets of signature words and phrases, and a callout on the biggest inconsistency found.

tools.title: Voice guide
tools.subtitle: A one-page guide for the team
tools.prompt: Write a one-page brand voice guide for the profile brand aimed at {audience}. Sections: text (the voice in a paragraph), a table (Trait | Sounds like | Not like), a second table of tone shifts by situation (Situation | Tone dial | Example line) covering welcome, error, complaint, launch and legal, a checklist writers run before publishing, and a quote with 3 example sentences that nail the voice.

tools.title: Rewrite on-brand
tools.subtitle: Any text → your voice
tools.prompt: Rewrite this for {context} in the profile brand voice, keeping the meaning and staying within 10% of the length: {text}. A quote with the rewritten text, a table (Original phrase | Rewritten | Why), and bullets on 3 further cuts if it needs to be shorter.

tools.title: Score a draft
tools.subtitle: How on-brand is it?
tools.prompt: Score this draft against the profile brand voice: {draft}. kv (overall score /100, tone match, vocabulary match, rhythm match, banned words found), a table of flagged lines (Line | Problem | Fix), a checklist of edits to make, and a callout on whether it's ready to ship.

tools.title: Tone dial
tools.subtitle: Same message, five tones
tools.prompt: Deliver the message '{message}' in the profile voice at five tone dials. Cards for Sorry-but-firm, Neutral, Warm, Upbeat and Playful (body = the full 40–80 word message, meta = when to use it), then a table (Tone | Opening line | Risk), and a callout on which tone fits both the message and the brand.
